subject: SIG questionnaire: control mapping, evidence proofing and demo cadence (Hightower Partners)
messages:
From: Ava Lin <ava.lin@hightowerpartners.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Marcus Boyd <mboyd@hightowerpartners.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hightower SIG questionnaire and evidence kickoff

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the quick intro — attached is our internal SIG spreadsheet (HTP_SIG_v1.xlsx). We've completed the initial pass and highlighted ~22 controls where we need artifacts or demonstrations specific to your platform (key management, retention, telemetry provenance, model variant fallbacks). Can Redwood provide: 

- A single consolidated evidence index mapping your controls to SIG/CCPA/SOC 2 assertions
- Samples of audit logs (redacted), recent change tickets for runtime, and key rotation proof of concept
- A short demo (30-40m) showing your private deployment tracing and how fallbacks operate during capacity constraints

We're aiming to present this to our InfoSec and Procurement on Apr 4 — can we get a proposed timeline for evidence delivery and a demo slot?

Attachments: HTP_SIG_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Ava Lin
Director, Vendor Assurance
Hightower Partners

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Ava Lin <ava.lin@hightowerpartners.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hightower SIG questionnaire and evidence kickoff

Hi Ava — thanks for the spreadsheet and the clear ask. We can definitely support the mapping and the demo. Quick plan below: 

1) Evidence index: we'll return a CSV that maps SIG control IDs to Redwood control references + artifacts (SOC 2 section, ISO 27001 clause, example evidence file name).
2) Artifacts: we can supply redacted audit log extracts (auth events + admin actions), a change management ticket bundle (Jira excerpts), and a KMS rotation schedule.
3) Demo: 35 minutes — 20m demo + 15m Q&A focused on private deployment observability and model fallback behavior. We'll not include production customer data — demo uses a synthetic workload.

Proposed timeline:
- Apr 2 EOD: evidence index + initial artifact list (partial artifacts where permissible)
- Apr 3 AM: handoff package (audit extracts + ticket excerpts) via the GDrive folder you shared
- Apr 4 11:00AM ET: demo with our infra engineer (Jonas) and I to join for the Q&A.

I'll include priyom for evidence collation and jonas for the demo. If that works, I'll upload an invite and the index CSV tomorrow.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Customer Assurance
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Boyd <mboyd@hightowerpartners.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Ava Lin <ava.lin@hightowerpartners.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hightower SIG questionnaire and evidence kickoff

Tessa — this looks good. Two clarifications from our procurement and cloud security reviewers: 

- For the audit extracts, we need timezone-aware timestamps and an index mapping event IDs to actor roles (admin/service/user)
- For KMS proof: we require the key rotation policy and an example of an HSM-wrapped key lifecycle (or equivalent if you use cloud KMS).

Also, procurement asks whether any of the artifacts will contain customer PII; if so, we need a redaction plan.

If you can confirm the Apr 4 demo at 11AM ET, we'll circulate invites to the wider team.

Thanks,
Marcus Boyd
Senior Procurement Manager
Hightower Partners

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Ava Lin <ava.lin@hightowerpartners.com>, Marcus Boyd <mboyd@hightowerpartners.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-02T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hightower SIG questionnaire and evidence kickoff

Hi Ava / Marcus — attaching the initial evidence index (redwood_evidence_index.csv) and a short inventory note in the Drive folder. Highlights: 

- Audit extracts: provided as "auth_admin_events_2028Q1.csv" with timezone offsets and event_id mapping to role tags in the index. All extracting scripts are run against synthetic/obfuscated data where production PII was present; redaction notes included.
- KMS: we don't publish HSM key material but have provided the rotation policy PDF and a signed attestation of managed KMS practices. For customers using our Private (VPC) offering, HSM integrations (BYOK) are supported — see the attachment references in the index.
- Change tickets: Jira excerpts are redacted for customer identifiers but include titles, timestamps, and approver names.

Action items for Hightower to review in the index: 
- Column F: evidence sufficiency (OK / Needs follow-up)
- Column H: delivery constraints (legal/NDAs required)

Demo invite and ICS attached. Please confirm who will join from InfoSec so Jonas can tailor the tracing portion.

Attachments uploaded to Drive: redwood_evidence_index.csv, demo-invite.ics

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Assurance Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Ava Lin <ava.lin@hightowerpartners.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, Marcus Boyd <mboyd@hightowerpartners.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hightower SIG questionnaire and evidence kickoff

Thanks Priyom — we reviewed the index and it's very helpful. A few follow-ups: 

- Could you add a sampled log snippet that includes an admin key-creation event (redacted actor) and a corresponding ticket ID? That will help our auditors validate traceability.
- For BYOK details: please include the onboarding checklist for customer-supplied keys (steps, required artifacts, & approximate lead time).
- Demo attendees: Myself, Marcus, and two InfoSec engineers (Liam O'Neill and Priya Shah). Liam wants to focus on TTLs/KV cache behavior during long-running sessions.

We'll accept the Drive folder delivery model and will execute any NDA steps if you note them in Column H. Confirmed for Apr 4 at 11AM ET.

Best,
Ava

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Ava Lin <ava.lin@hightowerpartners.com>, Marcus Boyd <mboyd@hightowerpartners.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-03T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hightower SIG questionnaire and evidence kickoff

Hi Ava / Marcus — thanks for the rapid review and the attendee list. Quick notes ahead of the demo tomorrow: 

- I've uploaded a sampled admin-key creation log snippet to the Drive folder (auth_admin_key_event_sample.txt) with full event_id mapping. The entry includes timezone-aware timestamps and a redacted actor line as requested.
- BYOK onboarding checklist (BYOK_onboarding_v1.pdf) is in the "Artifacts/Onboarding" subfolder. Lead time for HSM-backed onboarding is typically 4–6 weeks; standard cloud-KMS BYOK is 2–3 weeks depending on approvals.
- For TTLs/KV cache: I'll include a short segment in the demo showing how TTLs are configured per route and how prefix caching affects latency under long-running sessions. We'll also show a simulated fallback to a lower-quantized model variant and how telemetry marks the switch for traceability.

Looking forward to the session — invite should include a Zoom link and Drive bundle.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Infra Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
